text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days before the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text:
—And then I ignored the instructor's 
orders to do the training I wanted, so 
they got super mad at me.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text:
I'm stuck writing an apology essay after 
school! My shoulders are seriously killing 
me!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Haha... Idiot, your method is just sloppy.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If you've decided not to listen, make them 
accept that first. Otherwise—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The lights suddenly shut off. The BGM 
cranked up, and the underclassmen all wore 
smirks on their faces—

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh, Sirius-san! Don't move! And please, 
stay still for just a little bit!

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text: Hey, hurry, hurry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, when the lights that had suddenly 
gone out flickered back on—

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text: —Heheh, surprise!

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Juniors
text_block_list.text:
Sirius-san! Good luck taking on the 
overseas scene!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A mountain of presents was piled on the 
table.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa, that's an insane amount.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
So, what's with this sudden change, after 
all this time?

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior B
text_block_list.text:
It's become a huge topic on social media 
too, isn't it?! We're all so hyped up!

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text:
I want your dream to come true, 
Sirius-san! No matter what!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You're acting quite obedient. ...You're 
not plotting something weird, are you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing those teasing words, the 
underclassmen pout with a serious look on 
their faces.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text:
Please don't tease me! I just genuinely, 
totally adore you, Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text: Senpai is special to all of us!

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior C
text_block_list.text:
Those who couldn't get along with the 
instructors, those who felt their talent 
reached its limit and got cynical, and 
those who tried to drop out because of it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior C
text_block_list.text:
They taught me not to overlook things like 
that and to carve out my own path with 
certainty...

text_block_list.name: Timid Junior of Sirius
text_block_list.text:
"Senpai always showed us the way to live 
through her own actions...!"

text_block_list.name: Timid Junior of Sirius
text_block_list.text:
There's never been anyone else like that. 
Th... That's why! That's why I want to 
follow you!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Huh. Quite the love letter you've got 
here.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'll give ya headpats as a reward. Come 
on, sit and line up.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text: Wait, for real?! Woohoo!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...Just kidding. Like hell I'd do that, 
you idiots."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If it's a reward you want, I'll give it to 
you on the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—And that's why you hauled it all the way 
in here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While working late at night, Sirius 
Symboli and her juniors showed up at the 
Trainer's Room carrying heavy luggage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though I've only heard a brief summary of 
what happened... it seems she really is 
deeply adored.
choice_data_list:
First, I want to do my best in the 
Takarazuka Kinen.

First, let's do our best in the Takarazuka 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
... That was the plan from the start, 
wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite her words, her eyes looked 
unusually gentle as she gazed at the 
mountain of refreshments.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And... the day of the Takarazuka Kinen has 
finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I heard a rumor at the Fan Appreciation 
Festival. Something about Sirius Symboli 
aiming to race overseas!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering, 'What's it really like?' 
so I came over to take a look—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"It's a field packed with top talent, but 
the one you really want to keep an eye on 
is Sirius Symboli."

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, her name was once brought up 
as an overseas challenger under the 
Overseas Expedition Program. Her abilities 
should be beyond question, but...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Rumor has it that some of the URA staff 
don't think very highly of it...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Well aren't you stealing the 
spotlight completely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As attention on Sirius Symboli continued 
to grow—

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Juniors
text_block_list.text: Sirius-saaan! Good luuuck!!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Shut it. Sit there like a good girl.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Do that, and I'll show you what you're 
after.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A corner where shrill cheers ring out. 
With an imposing and dignified presence— 
the curtain rises on the Takarazuka Kinen!
